witness.ex: The witness described the thief to the police.
witness.pt: A testemunha descreveu o ladrão à polícia.

experiment.ex: In the experiment, people watched a short video and answered questions.
experiment.pt: No experimento, as pessoas viram um vídeo curto e responderam a perguntas.

steal.ex: Someone tried to steal a bike outside the café.
steal.pt: Alguém tentou roubar uma bicicleta na frente do café.

thief.ex: Before anyone could stop him, the thief ran away.
thief.pt: Antes que alguém pudesse pará-lo, o ladrão fugiu.

detail.ex: She remembered every detail about the man's jacket.
detail.pt: Ela lembrou cada detalhe da jaqueta do homem.

wrong.ex: His memory was wrong about the color of the car.
wrong.pt: A memória dele estava errada sobre a cor do carro.

culprit.ex: The police still don't know who the culprit is.
culprit.pt: A polícia ainda não sabe quem é o culpado.

accurate.ex: Her description was accurate, so they found him quickly.
accurate.pt: A descrição dela foi precisa, então o encontraram rápido.

recall.ex: I can't recall what the driver was wearing.
recall.pt: Não consigo lembrar o que o motorista vestia.

police report.ex: She signed the police report at the station.
police report.pt: Ela assinou o boletim de ocorrência na delegacia.

statement.ex: The witness gave a statement to the officer.
statement.pt: A testemunha prestou depoimento ao policial.

tattoo.ex: He had a small tattoo on his neck.
tattoo.pt: Ele tinha uma pequena tatuagem no pescoço.

scar.ex: He had a long scar over his left eyebrow.
scar.pt: Ele tinha uma cicatriz comprida sobre a sobrancelha esquerda.

getaway car.ex: A getaway car was waiting with its engine running.
getaway car.pt: Um carro de fuga esperava com o motor ligado.

license plate.ex: Did anyone see the license plate?
license plate.pt: Alguém viu a placa do carro?

security camera.ex: A security camera was recording when it happened.
security camera.pt: Uma câmera de segurança estava gravando quando aconteceu.
